info.name: nCino Mortgage Doc Package Orders API
🚧 List doc package orders for a loan (BETA)

params.name: order_group_id
params.description: Filter by order group ID. Use to poll all orders created by a single create request.

params.name: page_size
params.description: The number of records returned in each page.

params.name: created_after
params.description: The date which a resource must be created after to be returned.

params.name: created_before
params.description: The date which a resource must be created before to be returned.

params.name: updated_after
params.description: The date which a resource must be updated after to be returned.

params.name: updated_before
params.description: The date which a resource must be updated before to be returned.

info.name: 🚧 Create doc package orders for a loan (BETA)

items.docs:

This endpoint will create a <<glossary:doc package order>> for each borrower pair on a <<glossary:loan>>
and process them asynchronously. Poll the index endpoint with the returned
`order_group_id` to track status.

info.name: 🚧 Retry failed doc package orders for a loan (BETA)

items.docs:
> 🚧 Under construction
> **This endpoint is in beta.** Functionality may change without notice, support is limited, and use in production is not recommended. Your feedback is appreciated.

This endpoint will retry all failed <<glossary:doc package order>> for a given order group on a
<<glossary:loan>>. Optionally, a subset of doc package order IDs can be passed to retry only
those specific orders. Poll the index endpoint with the returned `order_group_id`
to track status.
